title: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition pre-orders: Price, bonuses, release details and more
summary: Pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI begin June 25, with the game launching November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Two editions, Standard ($79.99) and digital-only Ultimate ($99.99), are available.
